summary: Require distinct declared execution units and deterministic bounded-handoff chaining for credited Adaptive Execution passes, then revalidate the merged Adaptive Execution behavior under the corrected discipline.
reason: PR #5 revision 6 recorded five SEPARATED semantic stages as complete even though they were effectively evaluated within one assistant response. The correction adds deterministic enforcement of unique declared execution-unit/boundary identities, ordered handoff chaining, closed historical exemptions, gate-before-pass chronology, historical identity uniqueness, and immutable completed-pass evidence. Revision-8 Adversarial found and corrected three successive bypasses: omission of the PR base snapshot from historical identity checks; mutation of execution identity after durable completion; and an inability to represent subdivided execution honestly because subpasses were only recognized after the enclosing stage result became passing. The corrected model now recognizes each completed plan pass as a durable execution occurrence before stage credit, permits only an ordered prefix of a subdivided execution plan to be recorded, requires each pass to first complete in its own durable state with its gate already present, and withholds the semantic stage result until the full plan is complete. Completed pass evidence, including its handoff, is historically immutable. All gates created before these findings were discarded; Adversarial remains uncredited pending a fresh retry against the corrected state. The repository still does not claim to prove a ChatGPT message/context boundary unless the host supplies a trustworthy boundary ID.

supersedes_assurance.reason: The revision-6 semantic completion records overstated actual separation and are not used as evidence for the corrected review.
Revision-7 Adversarial completed before the historical uniqueness requirement for redo and subdivided execution occurrences was added; revision 8 therefore reopens from Adversarial.
